difficulty_reason: The statement produces a canonical spectral sequence of derived complete modules for a filtered complex, with first page given by the cohomology of the completions of the graded pieces, and states that it is bounded and converges to the cohomology of the completion when the filtration on each term is finite (statement lines 26555-26567). The proof represents completion as a Hom complex from a bounded complex of projectives of finite projective dimension, which requires the finite cohomological dimension statement, induces the filtration on that Hom complex, verifies that its associated graded computes the completion of the graded pieces, and then invokes the spectral sequence of a filtered complex together with the finiteness of the filtration, which follows from boundedness of the complex of projectives (proof lines 26569-26590). The identification of the associated graded is the step that ties the first page to the completion of the graded pieces. The counted span refers five times, two to results of this chapter and three to results of other chapters, all carried as navigation stubs.
